_about: Every fixed overworld spot that gives 5-star artifacts. Facts from the Genshin Impact Wiki (Hidden Trove, Tribal Secret Space, Kuuhenki's Hidden Trove, Secret Hall of the Realms, Shadow Realm Treasure Vault, Nine Pillars of Peace and each key item's page), checked 20 Nov 2026. Positions and pictures are the official map's own pins (map/pin ids below). Rendered by tools/build-artifact-troves.py.

regions.name: Mondstadt
regions.intro: One trove: the Noblesse Secret Treasury on Windrest Peak, the only trove that needs two keys instead of three.

troves.name: Noblesse Secret Treasury
troves.keyFrom: random Precious and Luxurious Chests in Windrest Peak
sets: A Day Carved From Rising Winds

regions.name: Liyue
regions.intro: No trove, but one quest vault with a guaranteed 5-star piece. It is a single flower, not a set.

troves.name: Nine Pillars of Peace
troves.keyFrom: offerings to the Geo Statues of The Seven in Liyue; read the inscription at the pin to start the world quest
troves.note: The back room also holds a Luxurious and a Precious Chest. Only the host can claim it in co-op.
